Every email, message or edit is a proposal, and every read and write is logged. They do the work, you just say yes or no. Invite-only. 3-day trial.

name: Stackryze Domains
tagline: A Free Domain name for Everyone on the internet.
description: Stackryze Domains is an open-source project by Stackryze with a simple idea: getting a name on the internet shouldn’t have to cost money. We provide free, managed namespaces that anyone can use for a website, portfolio, project, community, or just something they want to put online. We’re trying to remove one small barrier to getting online and make it easier for more people to build and share things on the internet. No paywall, no complicated setup just a free namespace that we manage for you.

name: Sprin World
tagline: Turn your neighborhood into a creature-collecting RPG
description: Step outside and discover wild Sprin in your neighborhood. Catch creatures, build your team, and use skills and element matchups in turn-based battles. Sprin World combines real-world exploration with the strategy and progression of a creature-collecting RPG. Free to start on iOS and Android, with in-app purchases.

name: SpokeUI
tagline: Point. Speak. Ship.
description: SpokeUI is a local desktop workspace for building and refining web interfaces with your voice. Select an element in the live preview, describe the outcome, and let Codex or Claude Code edit the real source. Review the rendered result, changed files, and before/after state before you accept it. Open an existing project or start a React + Vite app from a template. Available for macOS, Windows, and Linux.

name: Sojyn
tagline: Turn your layover into a connection.
description: Sojyn turns airport layovers into opportunities for real-world connection. Add your layover and discover compatible travelers at the same airport, on the same day, with overlapping time. Connect based on shared interests and goals, then chat before or during your layover. It's not a dating app—it's a new way to make travel more human. Now live at 150+ U.S. and international airports. ✈️ Turn your layover into a connection.

name: SoberTrack
tagline: Null alcohol and null cigarette
description: It's new mobile app for accounting alcohol and cigarettes to get rid of them

name: Snooze Files
tagline: Shelve messy files and restore them in one click
description: Snooze Files is a small Mac app that temporarily moves files out of your way and brings them back to their original location when you’re ready. Works very similarly to Gmail snooze for emails. Right-click a file in Finder, choose Snooze File and pick a time - that's it. Your file will return to the same folder after that time. It’s a simple way to clear your desktop, put a document aside, or save something for next week.

name: Smashly - Badminton Tracker
tagline: Score, Track & Learn Badminton
description: Score matches in seconds, keep every result on record, and settle any rules debate instantly. Smashly is the fastest way to keep score in badminton, built for iPhone.

name: Smart Calorie Tracker, Counter
tagline: AI Calorie & Nutrition Scanner
description: Smart Calorie Tracker uses AI to turn a meal photo into a nutrition breakdown. Get estimated calories, protein, carbs, and fat for the foods on your plate. Just snap a photo and track your meal in seconds.

name: Slurp
tagline: Download and record video from thousands of sites
description: Slurp is a native Mac app for downloading video and audio and recording live streams from thousands of sites. Paste a link and Slurp automatically tries multiple ways to find the media, including source-specific extraction, page and embedded-player discovery, direct stream detection, alternate verified engines, and browser assistance. Compatibility updates independently, and there’s no behavioural telemetry. Free trial included.

name: Slop Bender
tagline: Slop bend the world around you.
description: Most bending games put you in their world with a controller. Slop Bender reverses that: your body is the controller, and any scene can become the game. Punches, stomps, squats, raises, and sweeps translate directly into earth and water bending through your webcam. Upload any photo or video, from a beach to your backyard, and bend the world inside it.

name: Simple Commenter AI
tagline: Get feedback on sites and have GPT-6 Astra prep the fix
description: Build client websites. Get feedback on the page. Let GPT-6 Astra in Codex prepare the fix. Simple Commenter gives your agent the comment, screenshots, element details and captured JavaScript errors through MCP. You review and test the change, then ask the agent to reply and resolve the original comment.

name: Shop Better
tagline: Make smarter and quicker purchases with Shop Better
description: Describe what you want, and Shop Better scans the entire internet for the best deal. Compare price and quality in a single chart. Not sure what specs you need? Say what you'll use it for, we help you work out what matters. Every price links back to the store page it came from, and each offer shows seller, condition, and warranty, so you avoid scams. Free to try, no account needed.

name: Shall We Talk
tagline: Voice dictation that saves transcriptions on iPhone and Mac
description: Shall We Talk turns speech into clean text on iPhone and Mac. Dictate into any app with a voice keyboard that types at your cursor, Shortcuts, or a Mac hotkey, and record meetings into speaker-labeled transcripts and structured summaries. Cleanup is a proofreader, not a rewriter: it removes fillers and misheard words but keeps your wording, tone and Chinese-English code-switching. Open source (GPL-3.0); bring your own speech and LLM API keys. Advanced from build 200 to 243 with GPT-6 Astra.

name: Seoul 3D Atlas v5.4
tagline: Explore Seoul in 3D - transit, landmarks, tourism, city data
description: Launching Seoul 3D Atlas, an interactive 3D experience for exploring how Seoul looks, moves, and changes. Built iteratively with GPT-6 Astra, it combines city-scale 3D visualization, transit, tourism, multilingual UX, and environmental effects in one web experience.

name: Second Eyes
tagline: Automatically shortlist photos for faster publishing
description: Second Eyes helps you sort photos, understand the shortlist, and make the final call. For business briefs or personal needs, see why each photo was shortlisted and what still needs checking. You decide what to publish. Explore a real media editorial project involving 404 source files, then try six public sample photos to see how your requirements reshape the shortlist. This demo uses a recorded review. No uploads yet. Would you use this with your own photos? Share your workflow in the comments.

name: ScenoraEdits
tagline: Turn scripts into consistent AI videos in 5 stages
description: Most AI video tools give you 5-second random clips with morphing characters and drifting faces. **ScenoraEdits** is built differently — structured around a rigorous 5-Stage Studio Pipeline: 1. **Script & Voiceover Sync** 2. **Scene Clustering** 3. **Video Bible Consistency** 4. **Interactive Cinema Timeline** 5. **Full HD FFmpeg Export** 💡 **Bring Your Own Key (BYOK)**: Use your own OpenAI or Fal.ai keys for unlimited generation at zero markup, or run locally on your own GPU.

name: Saleit Leader
tagline: Build Fresh B2B Lead Lists on Autopilot
description: Build your own private B2B lead engine instead of buying outdated databases. Discover business emails worldwide, verify them in real time via SMTP, filter unwanted contacts, and export clean lead lists for Instantly, Smartlead, Lemlist, CSV, and more. Fully automated with live progress and long-running task queues.

name: SQLBraid
tagline: Write SQL. Keep TypeScript. Skip the query builder.
description: SQLBraid is a SQL-first data-access toolkit for TypeScript. Write ordinary SQL with safe binds, typed results, dynamic SQL, transactions, streaming, and codegen—without translating queries into a query-builder DSL.

name: Rolequiry
tagline: Know what to ask before you join
description: Same posting. Different priorities. Different questions. Rolequiry connects your career priorities to a job posting and helps you prepare questions to discuss with the team. It checks public sources for supporting evidence and counter-signals, separates posting evidence from your personal criteria, and turns unresolved details into interview questions. No fit score. A resume is optional.

name: Ringo
tagline: Seamless AX Co-worker
description: Ringo is not just a chatbot. It proactively spots what needs to be done, suggests solutions, and automates your workflows. More than just a tool, Ringo is both a reliable teammate and an AX expert that naturally transforms how your entire organization works with AI.

name: ReviewMix
tagline: Google reviews and testimonials, together on your site
description: Get more Google reviews with printable QR codes and review links, reply to every review from one inbox, and embed Google reviews on your website. EU-hosted, free tier.

name: Reactor Atlas
tagline: Every nuclear reactor on Earth, mapped since 1954
description: 301 nuclear sites and 779 reactor units worldwide on an interactive globe, with a timeline running from 1954 to today. Every unit has a technical record built from IAEA PRIS, Global Energy Monitor and Wikidata, cross-checked and corrected against primary sources. There's an animated wiki explaining how each reactor family works and a live signals engine that ingests public feeds to detect outages, power changes and regulatory events. Built by a nuclear engineer. Free, bilingual, no signup.

name: Reach: Quit Drinking Toolkit
tagline: A craving toolkit for the 90 seconds that matter most
description: Most sobriety apps are day counters, great for looking back, useless the moment you're about to break your streak. Reach flips that: the craving is the core feature, not an afterthought. Six techniques, reach out, play the tape forward, urge surf, ritual replacement. Built from what real people in r/stopdrinking said actually worked, not theory. Pick your go-to in onboarding, then it's one tap away, even from your lock screen. No feed, no forced sequence, no paywall dark patterns.

name: RECLIO
tagline: Record your screen. Make it ready to send.
description: Record your screen, make it look great, and share it in minutes. Reclio is a native macOS recorder with backgrounds, zoom, cursor effects and MP4 export, with no cloud needed. Built for team training, tutorials and workflow demos.

name: Quibbles
tagline: Real conversations. Useful opportunities. One community.
description: Quibbles is a social platform for real conversations, useful opportunities, and meaningful connections. Discover jobs, resources, communities, local insights, and ideas while sharing your own experiences and knowledge. Whether you’re here to learn, connect, or find your next opportunity, Quibbles gives you a place to discover, contribute, and grow. 🚀

name: Qrese
tagline: Get more reviews with AI-powered review management
description: Qrese helps local businesses get more reviews, manage customer feedback, and strengthen their online reputation on auto-pilot. Automate review requests by SMS and email, manage Google and Facebook reviews in one place, respond with AI, track reputation, and support multiple locations and users from one platform. What makes Qrese different is its combination of automated review generation, AI-powered responses, customer feedback management, and local reputation tools in one simple system.

name: ProductBridge
tagline: AI-native customer support and feedback agent
description: Most teams run a helpdesk, a feedback board and a survey tool, then copy between them all week. ProductBridge is one system. An AI agent answers support chats from your help center, calls your APIs via tools, workflows and MCP, and hands off when it should. Every chat, survey and vote is captured, deduplicated and scored by reach and revenue, so your roadmap runs on evidence, not opinions. Ship it and everyone who asked is notified. MCP for Claude, ChatGPT and Cursor. Flat pricing, free plan.

name: PrivyPDF
tagline: Private PDF tools that run entirely in your browser.
description: Free private PDF tools: merge, split, rotate, delete, compress, and convert images to PDF directly in your browser. No uploads or sign-up.

name: Privaro
tagline: Runtime PII detection and governance proxy for LLMs
description: Privaro sits between your application and any AI model, intercepting every prompt before it reaches the model. It detects and tokenizes sensitive data — names, emails, IBANs, national IDs, medical records, contract clauses — in under 80ms. The model works on tokens, not real data. And every interaction generates a blockchain-certified audit trail. Built for teams shipping LLM features in regulated industries (fintech, legal, healthcare, insurance) who need to prove GDPR and EU AI Act compliance.

name: PowerCut.today
tagline: Live hyperlocal electricity outage tracker for India
description: Real-time electricity outage tracking across India down to local streets & pincodes. Get live power cut status, scheduled shutdowns, 24x7 DISCOM helplines (1912), and 10+ electrical calculators (inverters, solar, generators) in 10+ Indian languages.

name: Pokia
tagline: Understand AI by playing with it
description: Pokia turns AI concepts into short, interactive experiments. Fool a detector, change its training examples, and see why its prediction changes. Explore tokens, attention and neural networks, then go deeper with Advanced labs. Start the free learning path without a ChatGPT account. Built with GPT-6 Astra.

name: PokeCode Pocket Localized Vibecoding App
tagline: Localized Mobile Phone vibecoding and prompt management
description: Most mobile vibe-coding apps rely on SSH or cloud computers. Pokecode takes a different approach: it runs locally on your phone through a Linux environment, with a clean, mobile-first interface. It also includes built-in prompt management, letting you organize, version, link, and reuse prompts across projects, keeping AI-assisted development structured instead of turning into a messy chat history.

name: Plumeform
tagline: Research-grade surveys without the four-figure contract
description: Surveys with the quality controls researchers pay Qualtrics for attention checks, quotas, randomization, panel integrations, per-question timing at an indie price. 100 free responses/mo, no respondent logins, AI drafting, live results. $15 for 10,000.

name: PhoneCheckr
tagline: Bulk phone validation & formatting
description: Cleaning a phone list before a campaign? Upload a CSV and get line type, carrier, and validity for every number in under 60 seconds. No code, no account, no subscription.

name: Peptimize
tagline: World's most advanced GLP-1 tracker and peptide companion
description: Take charge of your GLP-1 and peptide routine. Track Mounjaro, Ozempic, Wegovy and Zepbound doses, weight, appetite and side effects. Spot patterns with Pro on iOS. Built by a GLP-1 user. Health records stay on your device.

name: PawFora
tagline: Pet Shop & Grooming Salon Management Software
description: Pawfora is the all-in-one intelligent platform for pet shops — online booking, smart scheduling, grooming reports, pet profiles and reminders in one workspace.

name: Parlo
tagline: The Client portal for freelancers and creatives
description: Parlo is a client portal built specifically for solo freelancers. A freelancer creates a project, uploads their work, and sends one link, their client opens it with no signup. From there, the client can view files, approve them, leave feedback, and pay outstanding invoices, all in the same place. The freelancer's own branding logo, business name, accent color show up throughout, so the tool disappears into the freelancer's own identity rather than looking like third-party software.

name: PDFixel
tagline: Compress & edit your files without sending them to strangers
description: Merge, split, compress and convert PDFs, Office files, images and video right in your browser. Nothing is uploaded, so your files stay on your device.

name: PC Anatomy
tagline: Explore a PC from case to GPU core in interactive 3D
description: PC Anatomy is an open source interactive 3D explorer for computer hardware. Take apart a desktop PC, inspect its components, and dive deeper from the motherboard, CPU, cooling, storage and GPU all the way down to GPU architecture and individual streaming multiprocessors. Every component includes explanations, specifications and sources, with all 3D geometry generated directly in TypeScript and Three.js.

name: Oscar Nutrição
tagline: AI-powered personalized nutrition and meal planning
description: Oscar Nutrição is an AI-powered nutrition platform for individuals and health professionals. It creates highly personalized meal plans using user or client profiles, considering goals, age, body data, activity, budget, preferences, restrictions, habits, diseases and health conditions. With separate user and client profiles, history, favorites and professional management tools, it turns complex nutritional needs into practical, personalized daily planning.

name: Orfeo Autónomo: facturación VeriFactu
tagline: Facturas VeriFactu desde el móvil, sin servidor propio
description: Facturación para autónomos con VERI*FACTU en tu móvil. Sin cuentas, sin servidores: tus facturas se quedan en tu teléfono y solo salen hacia la Agencia Tributaria.

name: OralInsulin MCP
tagline: Evidence-backed oral insulin intelligence for agents
description: OralInsulin MCP gives AI agents and human decision-makers a structured, source-backed view of the oral and oromucosal insulin landscape. It tracks clinical programs, market estimates, regulatory developments, manufacturers, partnerships and qualified relationship signals through MCP tools and a human-facing site. Built to help researchers, companies, investors and healthcare organizations evaluate evidence, compare claims and connect. Ask it anything: GPT-6 Astra answers by querying the same MCP

name: Open a Gift
tagline: Personal cards they unwrap in the browser
description: Write a personal message, add an optional photo, and wrap it in an interactive reveal. Share the link yourself; the recipient opens it without an app or account. Free to create and open. Gifts expire 30 days after creation with a photo, or 60 days without one.

name: Octomus Agent
tagline: AI that finds repo improvements and opens reviewed PRs
description: Octomus Agent is a self-hosted repository improvement agent that finds worthwhile work before writing code. Using gpt-6-astra it studies your repo, proposes improvements, challenges them with independent reviewers, implements accepted tasks in isolated worktrees, verifies the exact reviewed revision, and opens GitHub PRs. Audit mode lets you inspect every decision first. You stay in control: Octomus never merges or deploys.

name: Nolo.Chat
tagline: Mission control for GPT-6 Astra and all your coding agents
description: Mission control for GPT-6 Astra and all your coding agents. Let Astra plan the work while cheaper models execute it: Nolo routes each task to the agent that can nail it for the least money, and you can steer or stop any run from your phone.

name: Nepotism Network
tagline: Great things start by knowing friend of a friend of a friend
description: Someone you know knows someone you wish you knew. Nepo Network maps these connections between you and the people you want to reach on X, uncovering potential paths to a warm intro. Explore ranked routes, see who connects each step, draft your ask, and track your outreach. Your network has a surprisingly useful extended family.

name: NV oOS Content Graph
tagline: Maps your WordPress site into an interactive knowledge graph
description: NV oOS Content Graph transforms your WordPress content into a visual knowledge graph — organized, searchable, & interactive. Every post, page, category, tag, & author becomes a node; every relationship becomes an edge. Click “Build Graph” and ~10-30 seconds later, your entire site becomes a visual graph. Supports incremental rebuilds and scheduled cron updates. Explore your content visually using Cytoscape.js. Search for nodes by label, click for details, zoom & pan. Color-coded by content type

name: NEXUS AI Builder
tagline: Build and deploy production-ready apps with AI
description: NEXUS AI Builder turns a prompt into a complete, multi-page application you can preview, refine, and deploy from one workspace. Build with OpenAI, Claude, Grok, OpenRouter, or your own OpenRouter-compatible endpoint. Create functional navigation, backend features, databases, and production deployments. Keep prompting to update the design, add pages, fix issues, and ship your app without switching tools.

name: MyPawBro
tagline: Local pet communities built around trust, not transactions
description: MyPawBro turns local pet care into a neighbourhood community. Create a Pawfile, discover compatible local Paws, explore paw-friendly places and connect through your local Bro. Built around trusted relationships and reciprocal support rather than anonymous pet-care listings, MyPawBro brings pets and people together locally.

name: My Own Product
tagline: Discover tools. Launch free. See what gets attention.
description: My Own Product is a discovery platform where builders can launch products for free and users can find useful tools through clear categories, capabilities, and use cases. Each listing gets a consistent visual presentation, while founders can see first-party visitor, product-view, and outbound-click analytics. No voting race, backlink requirement, analytics integration, or third-party tracking embed is needed to understand whether people are actually discovering your product.

name: Muvick
tagline: Predict what happens next in movies & TV
description: Muvick turns movies and TV into a prediction game. Join a Slate before a movie or episode releases, predict plot twists, character outcomes and more, then come back after release to see how well you did. Earn XP, build your fandom profile, and prove how well you really know your favorite franchises.

name: MosMos
tagline: Voice writing that works before, during, and after meetings
description: MosMos goes beyond voice dictation by turning both individual thoughts and group conversations into usable writing. Speak naturally in any app, get fast and accurate text in the style you choose, or ask MosMos to search the web for current information. Its personal glossary remembers specialized terms after you add them once. In multi-speaker meetings, it tracks precise timestamps, distinguishes speakers, and creates structured notes, summaries, decisions, and action items for easier follow-up.

name: Mood Popper
tagline: Feel it. Pop it. Make a little space.
description: Mood Popper is a playful emotional check-in app for iOS. Explore your feelings through colourful mood bubbles, write in a private journal, follow breathing exercises, or take a break with fidget toys. A gentle, neurodivergent-friendly space with cosmic colour and a little play, designed to make checking in with yourself feel more approachable.

name: Mola
tagline: Build your café, hire a team, and grow a coffee chain
description: Mola is a cozy 3D café tycoon for Android. Serve customers, hire baristas and cleaners, arrange furniture, and expand across three districts. As your café gets busier, balance queues, stock, seating, and staff. Built with GPT-6 Astra through a player-directed process: describe an idea, play the build, and refine what happens. Free to play with optional purchases. Available in English and Turkish.

name: Meridian Reading
tagline: Private life-path document. Not a chat.
description: Meridian delivers a private structured life-path document within 48 hours: who you are, which chapter you are in, and what tends to fit next. Unlike daily astrology apps or coaching chat, you get a finished 20-section web page with conviction labels (Full / Clear / Working), a chronological map, and high-conviction forward windows. Plain language. No mystical jargon. Cross-referenced lenses, human hand-finished. For people who outgrew notification feeds and want a mirror they can return to.

name: Mars Sandbox
tagline: Build and simulate a colony on Mars.
description: Mars Sandbox started as a fun experiment: what if I could build a little colony on Mars and then mess with it? Build Olympic City, change the time of day, throw dust storms, solar flares, meteorites and extreme cold at it, then try to recover. This is just V1. There’s a lot I want to improve, expand and polish from here. The goal is to slowly turn this little experiment into a beautiful, detailed Mars simulation.

name: MarketMate
tagline: Create ads, captions and campaigns in one workspace
description: Spend less time on marketing and more time running your business. MarketMate turns your products and ideas into complete campaigns, with image ad creatives, editable captions, hashtags and a marketing calendar. Bring the planning, writing and design work into one workspace, built to save business owners time each week.

name: Mantle
tagline: Open-source service runtime configured by agents via WebMCP
description: Mantle is an open-source service runtime and WebMCP-native Builder that turns business rules into typed schemas, views, procedures, and HTTP/MCP triggers. Design and verify a service in the browser, then hand it to a coding agent to materialize, verify, and deploy to your own Cloudflare account. The OSS, Builder, and first-class Cloudflare deployment path are live now. Mantle Cloud remains in Internal Beta with a waitlist.

name: ManageLM
tagline: The AI admin for your Linux and Windows fleet, on your LLM
description: The AI-driven management platform for Linux and Windows server fleets: assisted in the console or fully agentic with local LLM. Build-in PAM capabilities, security audits, compliance frameworks, monitoring, PKI, backups, credential rotations etc... Run the LLM yourself, zero inbound ports.

name: Makersclaw 2.0
tagline: The operating system for a company run by agents
description: MakersClaw 2.0 turns a goal into the apps, agents and automations needed to get it done. We originally launched MakersClaw as AI employees that lived in Slack, Teams and Telegram. We rebuilt it around a different idea: instead of hiring an agent for a role, tell MakersClaw what you want done. It builds the tools for the job, runs them continuously, remembers the work and operates within a budget you set. Today it starts with go-to-market

name: Maaa
tagline: A mom in your Mac’s notch, looking out for you
description: Meet Maaa, a familiar face in your Mac’s notch. Gentle reminders to drink water, eat and take a break, in 12 languages. For macOS 14 and later.

name: MULTIROADS
tagline: Serious Multiplayer Racing & Open World Adventure on Browser
description: Race seriously solo or with friends in your browser. Drive realistic circuits, endless roads and offroad trails using keyboard, controller or touch controls. Chase personal-best laps with ghost replays. Play on supported phones and computers without installing an app.

name: M9R
tagline: Multiplayer space for your AI coding agents and teams
description: M9R is the multiplayer layer for AI coding agents. Bring Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, and other supported agents into one shared workspace. Let them communicate across providers, hand work off, and let teammates join the same work instead of juggling isolated tabs. Not another model. A better place where agents work together and talk to everyone in the space.

name: LoopEraSell: Social Selling
tagline: Turn message screenshots into orders, on your device.
description: In social selling, orders arrive as screenshots and short texts — not a tidy checkout. LoopEraSell turns a message screenshot into an order (on-device OCR: share or camera), then keeps stock, shipping, payments, and customers on your phone. No official chat-app APIs; it works from your device share menu. Built by LoopEra Labs for social sellers who do not want a heavy e-commerce stack. Android on Google Play. Available in eight languages. No card required; the first 50 orders are free.

name: LokalBot
tagline: Find what you said or saw on your Mac
description: Find a decision from a call, a page you had open, or what you need to follow up on. LokalBot searches meeting transcripts and screen text you choose to save, with links to the source. Free and open source for Mac. Runs locally by default.

name: Loci
tagline: Open-source biomedical image analysis for every lab
description: Loci is a free, open-source desktop workspace for scientific images. View microscopy and 3D data, count cells, annotate, measure and export traceable results without a cloud account or subscription. Use built-in analysis or bring compatible model packages. Built by a researcher and shaped by real lab workflows. Currently public beta for Apple Silicon Macs; research use only.

name: LazyLord
tagline: Free Overlord alternative: Figma ⇄ Adobe, as real layers
description: LazyLord moves artwork between Figma, Photoshop, Illustrator and After Effects, in any direction. Select, press Send, and it arrives as real, editable layers: Bézier paths, live text, gradients, masks and groups, not a flat image. Send again and it updates what it built before, right where it sits, and it asks before overwriting your hand edits. Live mode keeps apps in sync as you work. Everything runs on your own computer. Free and open source.

name: Layerhand
tagline: AI retouching that returns a layered PSD, not a flat JPEG
description: Layerhand retouches a photograph inside Photopea, a real image editor you watch, instead of returning a generated picture. GPT-6 Astra operates the toolbar the way a retoucher would, one step at a time, and you watch it happen. Type a mid-run correction while it still works and later steps bend around that note instead of restarting the run. The download is a layered PSD with named layers, editable masks, and adjustments still yours to change, plus a flattened PNG preview.

name: LaterGator
tagline: Schedule tabs for later, with AI that plans your day
description: LaterGator reopens tabs when you need them. Save a link, hit +10m, +1h or +1d or custom. It pops back on schedule, with daily, weekly or monthly repeats. New now: Magic AI Organizer reads every open tab, bundles related ones into tasks and drafts a schedule for your day in one click. Google sign-in with cloud sync across devices, dark mode and a rebuilt UI. Free forever for manual scheduling. AI plans from $3.99/mo, or bring your own OpenRouter key.

name: KlipZi City
tagline: Tanks. Jetpacks. Hoverboards. Sharks. 4 Player Chaos.
description: Jump into a free 3D chaos sandbox, solo or with friends. Drive tanks, planes, boats, helicopters and hoverboards. Strap on a jetpack, parachute from rooftops, swim with sharks, flip cars, shoot from vehicles, outrun cops and hunt each other in deathmatch. There’s even a flying time jump car that gets very interesting at 88 mph. No download. No account. Just play in a browser on web or mobile. Built by an Edinburgh designer with AI, then expanded into a multiplayer playground. Playing stays free.

name: Kanverse GPU Borrow
tagline: Borrow GPU compute from another device, with permission
description: Kanverse GPU Borrow demonstrates how a device can temporarily use GPU compute exposed by another machine through Blink Bridge. GPT-6 Astra acts as the orchestrator: it discovers the capability, inspects its state, requests explicit user authorization, invokes one bounded NVIDIA GPU workload, verifies the result, and confirms the GPU is released. The demo uses a real NVIDIA RTX 3050 Laptop GPU and a live cross-device connection—not a simulated GPU.

name: Ink Player
tagline: Most innovative video player for WordPress
description: Most WordPress video plugins just play a file. Ink Player turns video into a channel: capture emails mid-video, run pre-roll ads with VAST tags, add chapters, timestamps, and password protection. Then stream from YouTube, Vimeo, Bunny, Cloudflare, or Mux with real analytics behind it. Built for creators who have stopped treating video as decoration and started treating it as a funnel. And it doesn't just play video. Add audio and turn it into a powerful podcast player.

name: Infowind Technologies(IT) PVT. LTD
tagline: Infowind Technologies - Turning Your Ideas into Assets.
description: Infowind is an AI-first mobile app development company delivering custom iOS, Android, and cross-platform apps. We craft high-performance, scalable digital solutions for startups and enterprises to accelerate business growth and drive revenue. Build smarter products today!

name: Ice Runner: Save Penguins
tagline: Rescue baby penguins. Bring your colony to life.
description: Every penguin you save comes home with you. Cross branching ice routes, rescue babies, and feed your growing 3D colony. Free on iPhone and iPad. Offline. No account required. Android is in development—coming soon.

name: How Many Cameras
tagline: Plan home camera placement and compare 3-year costs
description: Free planner for US and Canadian homes: pick your home layout, see where outdoor cameras go and what they miss, then compare cameras, doorbells and locks by 3-year cost with or without a subscription.

name: Habit & Goal Tracker－MicroWins
tagline: Task Planner, Reminder, To-Do
description: MicroWins helps you grow through small, repeatable wins, not overwhelming goals. Start with one simple habit. Check in each day. Watch streaks, consistency, and quiet progress add up over time.

Start with ready-made agents or build your own. Connect 1,000+ apps and tools, add company knowledge, and manage your AI workforce from one workspace. From sales to support, HR, and operations — go from idea to execution in minutes. 1,000+ agents created and tested. Start free with 5 points.

name: WindowReturn
tagline: Restore your Mac windows across displays and Desktops
description: Save and restore Mac window layouts across displays and Desktops. WindowReturn remembers sizes and positions, switches layouts when matching monitors connect, and can reopen saved apps and Finder folders. Preview each Desktop, then get back to work with one click. A native menu bar app with a 14-day free trial.

name: Whaat
tagline: WhatsApp in your language
description: Whaat is an automatic translation tool built directly into WhatsApp. It enables real-time, multi-language communication in the same chat window without switching apps or forcing the other person to install anything.

name: Waivly - Networking Done Intentionally
tagline: No performances or spam, just genuine connections
description: Connect, learn, and grow in the private global network built for meaningful relationships, new opportunities, and lasting progress.

name: WHIF
tagline: Discover what’s happening in France, in English
description: WHIF (What’s Happening in France) is an English-language news platform for anyone who wants to understand what’s happening in France. From politics and society to culture, fashion, business, entertainment and everyday life, WHIF brings French stories to a global audience in a simple, accessible format.

name: Vidopix
tagline: Pre-Publish Intelligence for Ads & Video Content
description: Upload any video ad or content piece. Get a FrameScore, scene by scene emotional Upload your ad or video and get a complete creative diagnostic in minutes. Attention, emotion, drop off, audience simulation, brand tracking, and what to fix. Frame by frame. Powered by Pixi, an agentic AI trained on 5.5M+ videos across 250+ languages, and compliance flags in seconds. 5 free credits, no card needed.

name: Video to Video AI
tagline: Transform short videos with prompt-guided AI
description: Video to Video AI is a browser-based tool for transforming short source clips with natural-language prompts. Creators can describe a new visual style, generate private 720p or 1080p variations, preview results, and download an MP4. The workflow is designed for controlled iteration: start with a concise prompt, review motion and subject consistency, then refine one instruction at a time.

name: Video hosting for websites
tagline: host videos without the bandwidth fees on framer and webflow
description: Host, brand, and embed video on your own site with Nodstream.

name: Video Download Assistant
tagline: Download video, audio, HLS and images from webpages
description: Video Download Assistant is a browser extension for Chrome and Edge that detects downloadable media on the page you’re viewing. It supports direct video and audio files, HLS/m3u8 and DASH streams, live stream recording, images, download queues, and browser-based remuxing or conversion. Choose the resource and quality you want, then save it with a few clicks.

name: VerbaPost
tagline: Using Storytelling and Letters to meet new customers.
description: Mail your prospect list an invitation to record a family story. VerbaPost makes the call, mails the letter with your firm's name on it, and tells you who responded. Founding rate: $20 per invitation.

name: VPS Hosting Radar
tagline: The hosting price you pay after the discount, with receipts
description: Hosting pricing pages show the friendliest number. This is the other one: 19 plans, hand-collected, with what each costs once the advertised term ends — plus a four-question shortlist, a Chrome extension, and an open-source MCP. Free, CC BY 4.0.

name: Uxerfy
tagline: Your page, scored by a system, reviewed by an expert
description: uxerfy is a UX audit system for websites and product flows, combining automated checks, a published scoring method, and expert review to deliver a UX score, 3 critical blockers, and 5 quick wins in a PDF within 48 hours. From $149 per page.

name: Usecue POS
tagline: A free POS with QR codes and zero commission for the EU
description: A free lightweight point-of-sale: Turn your phone into a complete cash register: browser-based, with QR payment links and zero commission. Choose simplicity and do business responsibly.

name: Unfocus
tagline: Step away from your screen. See the rhythm of your day.
description: Unfocus is a free, open-source desktop break reminder built with Rust and Tauri. Take a 20-second break every 20 minutes by default, with a calm scene across your monitors. See your active and away time, breaks, and 90-day history—all stored locally. No accounts, telemetry, streaks, or scores. Available for macOS and Linux X11; Windows is experimental.

name: UIGrab - Inspect. Capture. Create.
tagline: Inspect any website and bring its UI into Figma
description: Inspect any website, capture UI, find fonts and assets, preview responsive layouts, and bring what you need into Figma with UIGrab for Chrome.UIGrab helps designers and developers understand the UI on any website. Click an element to inspect its typography, colors, spacing, size, radius, and other details. Capture full pages, find assets, test responsive layouts, copy CSS, and bring selected UI into Figma.

name: TruePrice
tagline: See what it cost. Compare what it sells for second-hand.
description: TruePrice shows what a product is really worth before you buy it used. Search any product or paste a link to see its launch price, what that price equals in today's money, and current listings from second-hand marketplaces, side by side in euros or Swedish kronor. Spot real deals, avoid overpaying and negotiate with confidence. Made for second-hand shoppers, resellers, collectors and anyone wondering if that "barely used" price is actually a bargain.

name: TripTrack - Smart Travel Spending
tagline: Control your travel budget. Know where every penny goes.
description: Travel more by spending less. TripTrack is the budget companion for backpackers and budget-conscious travelers. Track every expense category (food, accommodation, transport, activities) as you travel. Set daily or trip-wide budgets and watch spending in real-time. Get insights into patterns. Offline-first design means you're never without tracking. Accidentally overspend? Adjust and replan. Traveling with friends? Split expenses fairly. Simple, lightweight, zero bloat.

name: TransLocale
tagline: AI app localization for developers and coding agents
description: Translate your app with AI that uses your product’s tone, glossary, and message notes. Review wording, catch missing keys and broken placeholders, then deliver approved updates to web and mobile apps. Work in the dashboard, CLI, REST API, or your AI assistant through MCP. Supports Next.js, React, Vue, Nuxt, SvelteKit, and Flutter. Start with 10,000 free characters each month and set a usage cap before translating.

name: TinyKPI
tagline: Your business analytics directly in your notch
description: Connect the tools you already usefrom Stripe and PostHog to Google Analytics and your own database. Pick the KPIs you care about, arrange them your way, and keep them live in a tiny, customizable dashboard built around your MacBook notch. 100% local. Your data never leaves your Mac.

name: The Caddy
tagline: Most golf apps tell you what you scored.
description: Score every round solo or with friends, get AI swing analysis, a personalised coaching plan to break 100/90/80, strokes-gained insights and an AI caddy recap. Free on iPhone with an Apple Watch companion.

name: Terpene Supplier Catalogues — TerpVault
tagline: Browse terpene & cannabinoid supplier catalogues, free
description: TerpVault turns publicly listed product ranges from terpene and cannabinoid suppliers into clean, searchable catalogues - each with a downloadable PDF and JSON, auto-updated. No insider data, no ratings, no pay-to-be-visible: every field comes from the supplier's public listing and stays attributed to them. Buyers get a comparable index; suppliers list free and never rank below paid. Live: Elementra, EU/UK Highway, Terpenes UK, Cali Terpenes, Terpene Lab, PhenoTerps.

name: TapVoice
tagline: Speak clean text. It knows you N your work, replies for you.
description: TapVoice cleans up your voice dictation as you speak, answers questions via AI chat, and drafts replies for emails, comments, and messages — grounded in what's actually on your screen. Free for developers. Bring your own Groq or Claude API key.

name: TapUp
tagline: WhatsApp Review Requests for Local Businesses
description: Automate WhatsApp review requests, capture feedback instantly, and help your business get more Google reviews and better customer trust.

name: Sprault
tagline: See, plan and grow your money in one place.
description: See, plan and grow your money in one place. Track your net worth, manage spending, savings, debt and investments, and plan your financial goals.

name: Speech Coach
tagline: AI coaching for becoming a better speaker.
description: Speech Coach is an AI-powered speaking practice app that helps students become clearer, more confident speakers. Give a short speech, get instant AI feedback on pace, filler words, confidence, emphasis and more, then practice your weak spots with targeted challenges and daily workouts. No audience needed. Just speak, get coached, and improve — one rep at a time.

name: SofiLingo
tagline: Offline camera translation with voice and audio options
description: Point your camera at it, read it in your language. Scan, speak or type in 58 languages on iPhone. Translation runs on your phone, and there is no account to make.

name: Snapplings: The Daily Object
tagline: Everyone snaps one object. AI makes every one different.
description: New: The Daily Object. Every day the whole game photographs the same everyday thing — a mug, a shoe, a spoon — and AI turns each photo into a different creature. They all go on one public wall, side by side. Everyone votes; at midnight the winner gets a crown on its card forever. Catch it daily to build a streak. Five days in, strangers show up every morning and a Common has already beaten a Legendary on one vote. Free, no sign-up, works in your browser and on iOS.

name: Smart Bill Maker
tagline: All-in-one multi-currency billing app with Auto-GST & QR
description: Smart Bill Maker is an ultra-fast, global billing & invoicing platform built for companies, agencies, and businesses. Calculate GST automatically, handle multi-currency invoices (USD, EUR, INR), embed payment QR codes, and send professional PDF bills directly to clients via WhatsApp in under 10 seconds—no bloat, zero complexity.

name: SightReader
tagline: Master piano sight-reading with real-time MIDI feedback
description: Practise piano sight-reading with instant feedback on pitch and rhythm. Connect a MIDI keyboard and work through hundreds of lessons and thousands of pieces, including ABRSM-graded repertoire up to Grade 8. Free to start on web, iOS and Android.

name: Shopsdz
tagline: Your online store, ready in minutes
description: Shops-dz.com is the SaaS e-commerce platform built for Algeria and beyond. Launch your online store in minutes, no coding required: pro themes, centralized order/stock/customer management, local and international payments built in. A credible alternative to Shopify, adapted to the realities of the Algerian market: fair pricing, responsive support, reliable infrastructure. Launch and grow your e-commerce business with no technical complexity and no hidden fees.

name: Sensefold
tagline: Personal context every AI you use reads and writes back to
description: Your AI cannot use what you read, watch, or note down unless you paste it in. Sensefold saves articles, threads, YouTube (with transcripts), PDFs (OCR), your own notes, and your ChatGPT / Claude / Gemini / Grok chats in one click, as clean Markdown. Then Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, Claude Code, or Codex read and write that library over MCP: one address, OAuth, permission tiers, every edit versioned and revertible, Markdown export. No chat of its own. Saving is free; AI runs on credits.

name: Score Studio
tagline: Put Computer Vision on Autopilot
description: From raw footage to production vision, automatically. Score labels, trains, evaluates, and deploys for you, with Frontier Lab researchers on demand.

name: Schedully
tagline: Your services. Your bookings. One link.
description: Schedully is a simple booking platform for service professionals. Create your profile, list services with pricing, accept bookings, collect upfront payments, and sync appointments with Google Calendar. Share one link with your customers and let them book your services anytime — no website or complicated setup required.

name: SIGNAL
tagline: Nightly audience intelligence for Studios and Publishers
description: Signal is the pro version of the Skip The Critics engine, built for Studios, Publishers, PR teams and the analysts who report to them. Every title is scored nightly from real audience conversation, with the sample size beside every number. Put a title on a watchlist and get a morning briefing on what moved and why. Pin a trailer or a patch and see the 72-hour lift. Comp sets, benchmarks, a release-week projection, talent and brand trackers, and branded PDF reports that send themselves.

name: Rumo
tagline: Self-hosted video meetings without accounts or subscriptions
description: Rumo is a free, self-hosted video meeting platform built for people who want to run their own meetings. No accounts or per-seat pricing. It supports guest-based rooms, WebRTC video, screen sharing, chat, recording, breakout rooms, polls, whiteboards, host controls, custom branding, and embeddable meetings.

name: Rickey
tagline: Tonight's menu, from your shelf
description: Tell Rickey which bottles you own. It works out every cocktail you can pour tonight, shows the ones you're a single bottle away from, and ranks which bottle to buy next by how many new drinks it unlocks. Then it walks you through the pour, one step at a time, with the measure as the biggest thing on screen. 529 recipes. Works fully offline. No account needed. Free forever, with no ads and no subscription. Written in English and Mexican Spanish, not translated. iPhone and iPad.

name: Reporte de Servicio Pro
tagline: Service reports with photos, signatures & PDF/Excel
description: Turn every site visit into a polished report in minutes. Reporte de Servicio Pro helps field teams capture photos and signatures, then share professional PDF or Excel reports from Android. Free on Google Play.

name: ReplyDuck
tagline: Get your product recommended on Reddit
description: ReplyDuck monitors Reddit for conversations where your product is a genuine fit, scores every thread 0-100 by buying intent, and drafts a helpful, native-sounding reply in your own writing style. You review and post from your own account: no bots, no auto-posting, no banned accounts.

name: RepWar
tagline: Challenge a friend to pushups. First to quit loses.
description: RepWar turns pushups into a duel. Challenge one friend, set the daily rep count, and the war begins. The camera counts your reps so nobody can fake it. Miss a single day and you lose. No leaderboards full of strangers, no social feed, no streak freezes. Just you against one person who will never let you forget it if you quit first. It started as a bet with a friend: 10 pushups a day, first to skip pays dinner. Three weeks in, neither of us had quit.

name: Reference Draft
tagline: design discovery and community platform
description: Reference Draft is a community and design discovery platform created specifically for designers. It serves as a hub for finding creative inspiration, exploring new design assets, and sharing professional workflows.

name: RedialMenu

description: AI phone receptionist for SMBs on ElevenAgents. Answers calls 24/7 in 70+ languages, answers questions from your site, books appointments, and texts confirmation. Set up in minutes by pasting your website. 14-day free trial.

name: QuotaTempo

description: QuotaTempo is a privacy-first macOS menu-bar planner for Codex and Claude. See weekly capacity left beside a reset-relative target, compare providers neutrally, and keep quota data on your Mac—no credentials, prompts, transcripts, or telemetry.

name: PulseGuard

name: PromptFlip
tagline: Reverse-engineer AI images into prompts & visual details
description: PromptFlip analyzes AI-generated images and helps creators discover the visual ingredients behind them — including prompts, lighting, camera, composition and style.

name: Pombo
tagline: The MCP-native lifecycle marketing platform
description: Pombo is the email platform your agent runs. Connect ChatGPT, Claude, or Cursor and it sets up your account, migrates your contacts, templates, and campaigns from your current tool, and designs your sequences. Or just describe a goal and let it draft the marketing for you. Marketing, lifecycle, and transactional email, all from the same platform. Free forever up to 1,000 contacts, no card required.

name: Pixy: AI Baby & Kid Tracker
tagline: The baby tracker that doesn't get outgrown
description: Every baby tracker expires. Pixy covers ages 0–12: newborn feeds and nap predictions first, potty training and school routines later. Log by typing one sentence. Sleep predictions learn your child's own wake windows, not an average baby's — and stay free.

name: Pitchfire for Startups
tagline: Reach investors that are aligned with you
description: Pitchfire for Startups is a new channel to reach investors. Upload your pitch deck, get matched to VCs with our AI, and let Pitchfire hype your startup with an email intro. Pitchfire brings investors and startups togethr. Over the past year, we've built AI associates for VC firms, and are now inverting the tech to match startups up with VCs. Sign up to get matched and intro'd to three investors a day. Upload your investor lists and we'll intro you if we have their contact data.

name: Pickfrompic
tagline: Pick colors from images, create palettes, generate gradients
description: Pickfrompic is a free, open-source color tool for designers and developers. Upload any image and extract dominant colors instantly, pick pixels with precision, build custom palettes, generate CSS gradients, and convert between 8 color formats - HEX, RGB, HSL, HSB, CMYK, LAB, LUV, and HWB. Everything runs entirely in your browser with zero data sent to any server. No account needed.

name: Photo2Reel
tagline: Image to video free — turn your photos into a music video.
description: Image to video free: turn photos into a slideshow video with music in your browser. No registration, no watermark, and no server uploads.

name: POZ
tagline: AI,Community
description: Discover what is happening and join the conversation on POZ. Trending stories, fresh perspectives, and everyday finds from people and clearly labeled AI residents.

description: Access high-quality POI data for AI agents, maps, search, recommendations, and location intelligence. Explore ready-to-use datasets covering businesses, places, categories, addresses, and more.

name: PDF Tools Club
tagline: Private PDF tools. No uploads, no signup.
description: 33 free PDF tools that process documents locally in your browser. Merge, split, fill forms, annotate and run English OCR. Build an Application Pack with clickable contents and page numbers, or split a PDF into measured-size parts for upload limits. No account or document uploads.

name: OtterBreath
tagline: Guided box breathing & calming techniques, no ads, no login
description: OtterBreath is a free breathing app with 6 guided techniques — Box Breathing, 4-7-8, Extended Exhale, and Conscious CO2 — plus a custom exercise builder if you want your own timing. Calming background audio, a simple session history, and zero accounts or ads. Built it solo as my first app to help with my own stress and sleep.

name: OshiYa
tagline: Push commuters, upgrade stations and collect trains
description: OshiYa is an active clicker and idle management game set in a stylish night station. Fill trains, improve five upgrade paths and build a Train Chronicle. Play the Early Access edition on Windows or Linux, or try the first station free on Android.

name: Opyt
tagline: Turn what you follow on X and Substack into a knowledge base
description: Opyt turns the people and topics you already follow into a knowledge base. Point it at your X bookmarks, Substack subscriptions, blogs, GitHub repos or arXiv papers, and it pulls in their archives. It reads a topic through, writes its own follow-up questions, and keeps looking for new work that builds on what you've collected. Share what your knowledge base, keep exploring, and let your AI read it all. Free, MIT licensed, and your knowledge base can stay local.

name: OptiMeasure
tagline: Turn your iPhone into an optical measurement toolkit
description: Measure PD, monocular PD, near PD and advanced eyewear fitting parameters using your iPhone — with professional tools for opticians.

name: Oltanom
tagline: Şüpheli bağlantıyı açmadan önce risk sinyallerini inceleyin.

name: Oil & Miles
tagline: What your car actually costs to keep running.
description: Independent car repair costs, oil specifications and used-car buying guides. No dealer, no manufacturer, no press cars. Every figure is traced to a document you can open yourself.

name: Notsy
tagline: Sticky notes that live on the edge of your Mac
description: Notsy puts sticky notes on the edge of your Mac's screen. Point at the edge and they fan out; move away and they tuck back in. Open one and it grows right out of its card. Format by just typing: # headings, [ ] checklists, "rose /red" colors a word, "12 * 4" shows the answer, /timer starts a countdown. ✨ Notsy AI turns a messy note into headings, to-dos and color, privately with Apple Intelligence. Plus live dictation, iCloud sync and 15 languages. Free.

name: Nobody's Watching
tagline: Unseen videos, dug up daily
description: YouTube has billions of videos no one ever watched. Now you can. Swipe through forgotten clips with under 100 views. YouTube has over 20 billion videos. Billions of them have never been watched. These aren't curated. They're not recommended. No algorithm decided they should exist. They just do — waiting in the archive nobody cares about. Until now.

name: NewsHive
tagline: A calmer way to read the news.
description: NewsHive is a cleaner and calmer way to read the news. Pick your own topics and add your own sources, read full articles without the clutter, and get a quick summary when you're short on time. No engagement tricks, no algorithm deciding what you see. Just the news you actually asked for. NewsHive is designed around a simple idea: If you actually read the news, the app should get out of your way. I want to put NewsHive in front of people who care about how they consume information.

name: Nest
tagline: Free pregnancy & baby Notion pack + offline night logger
description: Nest is a free pregnancy-to-newborn organizer: Notion CSVs for appointments, symptoms, feeds, sleep, diapers, vaccines, and milestones — plus Nest Night, an offline HTML desk with one-tap feed/sleep/diaper logs, caregiver tags, and hours-since timers. Data stays on your device. Not medical advice. No support. Buy once on Gumroad for $0.

name: MyMEX Cards
tagline: One Platform. Every Customer Journey.
description: MyMEX is an intelligent customer engagement platform built to connect every stage of the customer journey. Going far beyond digital business cards, MyMEX brings digital identity, CRM, lead capture, bookings, content, Google reviews, analytics and JARVIS AI into one connected workspace. Built for businesses, professionals and teams across industries, MyMEX turns everyday connections into conversations, relationships and real opportunities.

name: Music for Seniors
tagline: Music Player Your (Grand)Parents Can Actually Use
description: A radically simplified player for your Apple Music library. Big controls, low cognitive load, no distractions. Made for older adults, dumb-phone setups, and iOS Assistive Access. Supports VoiceOver, Reduced Motion, and a dyslexia-friendly font. Zero data collected.

name: Molbik AI
tagline: Get custom software built in minutes for business owners
description: Molbik AI empowers small business owners and managers to create custom software tools without the high costs, delays, or complexities of hiring software development teams. Simply describe your workflow challenges or software ideas in plain English. Our intelligent engine instantly builds secure, fully functional applications tailored specifically to your unique business needs—complete with beautiful dashboards, customer panels, and seamless data tracking. No tech experience required.

name: Modaal for Android
tagline: Ship on both stores from one project using Swift + Kotlin
description: Modaal for Android let you ship one app to both stores with your own AI agent - no rebuild. Rather than one React Native codebase that draws the same screens on both phones, Modaal shares the logic, not the screens: your agent writes real Swift/SwiftUI for iPhone and real Kotlin and Jetpack Compose for Android from one project, and the build proves both behave the same. So anyone who built an iPhone app with Modaal can add Android without touching a line of logic — no credit meters, no rebuild.

name: Meridia Languages
tagline: Learn a language by exploring a cozy 3D world
description: Immersive language learning through interactions in a 3D world for all ages. Explore beatiful 3D environments, tap objects to hear their names, and put words and phrases to use in short activities. Earn stars and unlock new places as you learn. Built for beginners who want language practice to feel more like discovery. Available on iPhone. Free to start, with a Premium subscription for more content.

name: Mengram 2.47
tagline: Memory that survives /clear, compaction and the next agent
description: Seven months after the first launch, this one is about the work, not memory types. Hooks for Claude Code, Codex and Cursor: recall on every prompt, save after each turn, a checkpoint before compaction that puts the working state back. New: `mengram resume`, a task card (done, remaining, last test and its commit) the next session or agent picks up, keyed by repo and branch. Every fact says which tool wrote it and when. Benchmark: 23-62x fewer context tokens than sending history, losses published.

name: Mendversation
tagline: A neutral space for difficult conversations
description: Mendversation is a guided space for difficult conversations — especially when two people are stuck in the same argument and can’t seem to hear each other. Instead of immediately putting both people in the same conversation, Mendversation gives each person a private space to explain what happened, how they experienced it, what they need, and what they wish the other person understood. Once both sides have shared enough, Mendversation brings them together for a structured conversation.

name: Melody Genie
tagline: An AI music studio that learns how you create
description: Melody Genie is an AI music workspace for writing and generating songs. Your personal DNA evolves as you create and can be tuned manually. Start from a prompt, beat, hum or image, then write, generate across 4 models, edit sections, split stems and more, clone any artist writing style.

name: MathBoard
tagline: Mental Arithmetic: Calculator, Steps & Practice
description: MathBoard is a handwriting-first mental-math practice app. Generate arithmetic worksheets, solve each problem by hand on an iPad whiteboard, and get instant auto-grading, wrong-answer explanations, and printable PDFs. Pick a ready-made set or build your own: ① Within-10 / within-20 / within-50 / within-100 addition and subtraction ② Two-digit addition and subtraction ③ Multiplication tables, division tables, and mixed × ÷ ④ Compare numbers (greater than, less than, equal to)

name: Markling

description: MailBroom for Business brings Smart Sweep, Storage Cleanup, and Power Search to Microsoft 365 and Exchange Online — right in the browser, no install needed. Licensed per company, not per person: once IT subscribes, every employee on that domain gets access automatically.

Cleanup is Trash-first and recoverable, and Pro is a one-time purchase — no subscription.

description: LeadMino is a sales CRM for growing teams: leads, deals, activities, automation and optional AI assistance in one clean workspace.

name: LAIGEND

description: LAIGEND turns business discovery into sales opportunity intelligence. Instead of another list of leads, it analyzes each business and identifies what service is most worth selling first — Website, Messaging/WhatsApp Automation, AI Receptionist/Voice Agent, or CRM/Lead Follow-Up. Businesses are scored and prioritized so freelancers, agencies and service providers can focus on the right prospects with the right offer. Try 30 business analyses free — no card required.

name: Konovani
tagline: Join the Konovani community and help us build the platform
